blocks.text: 智慧溫控器規格書 Thermostat Spec
本規格書說明第二代智慧溫控器的硬體需求與安裝方式。This document covers the hardware and installation of the second-generation thermostat.
下表列出主要元件的規格與數量，數值以量產版本為準。The table lists the main parts used in production units.
安裝注意事項 Installation Notes
安裝前請確認下列事項。Check the following items before installation.

items: 拆除舊機前請先關閉電源。Turn off the power first.
建議安裝在離地約 150 公分處。Mount it about 150 cm high.
設定完成後請更新韌體。Update the firmware after setup.
